basis: Calibration from overall dimension annotations 25000x20000 mm mapped to observed outer wall faces: x px282->1437 = 0->25.0 m, y px1235->310 = 0->20.0 m (scales 21.65 and 21.62 mm/px agree within 0.15%). Dimension baselines are the outer faces of exterior walls (240 mm = 11 px, verified on all four sides); interior partitions are measured line-pair centrelines (~5-6 px ~= 110-130 mm). Windows measured as cyan ink extents, doors as cyan jamb marks; grey wall ink rgb~150 tol 80, cyan rgb(11,164,144) tol 90.
